notes:
Run 2026-11-05, partial. College of Veterinarians of Ontario (cvo.org): only the 'Find a Veterinarian' page opened; it links to a JS register (cvo.ca.thentiacloud.net) that gives no usable list. ovma.com, ovchsc.ca (OVC Health Sciences Centre emergencies page), animalhealthpartners.com, ctvrc.ca, vectoronto.com and hamiltonevc.ca/contact were refused or not reachable (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED / fetch failure) and skipped, so OVC Guelph is NOT included; uoguelph.ca/ovc/care only said hospitals need a referral. Several hospitals therefore rely on referring clinics' pages (noted per entry). Not covered: Windsor (news item about a planned 24-hour ER could not be opened), Kingston, Sudbury, Thunder Bay, Collingwood/Blue Mountains, Niagara Falls, Guelph (Campus Estates Animal Hospital, 519-837-1212, only seen as a referral name), rest of Muskoka. No duty_rota entries: no opened page states who is on duty. Check: 16 checked, 0 fixed, 0 downgraded, 0 removed (independent check 2026-11-05: all 12 emergency_24h entries incl. both poison lines confirmed on their source pages; 4 of 17 others sampled: Burlington VERH, Animal Health Services, Secord, Kingsway; no duty rotas present).

Run 2026-11-05, Quebec, partial: Not covered (left): Gatineau/Outaouais, Sherbrooke, Saguenay beyond Chicoutimi, Mont-Tremblant/Laurentides, Gaspé, Quebec City Vet et nous clinics (Cimon, Beaumont, Ormière, Laurentides), Montréal/North Shore Vet et nous clinics (Verdun, Pierrefonds, Ville St-Laurent, Blainville, Ste-Thérèse, Saint-Jérôme) - addresses/phones are on the Vet et nous region pages but individual pages were refused (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). OMVQ site and the OMVQ 1-844-ANIMAUX press release (newswire) were refused; centredmvet.com/en/nous-joindre blocked by robots. Search found no official sites for Gatineau, Sherbrooke, Mont-Tremblant, Gaspé clinics. Poison lines: not duplicated (ASPCA, Pet Poison Helpline already in CA.json under Ontario; the exporter should show them for Quebec too if region-specific). Daubigny and CHUV hours rest on their own pages; CHUV contact page itself lists weekday office hours only.
